masthead.purpose: Page-one wordmark at issue scale, uppercase, overprinted with its own ghost. Front page only.

numeral.purpose: Table-of-contents rank set in its own column at plate scale. Only where order is real information.

headline.purpose: The entry spread's title and empty-state lines.

title.purpose: Titles in the contents list, clamped to two lines.

caption.purpose: The editor's one-line reason under each entry, two lines max.

stamp.purpose: The whole label layer: section names, issue line, quota, credits, format tags, key hints.

shadows.name: plate-shadow
shadows.purpose: A plate resting on the sheet. Night run: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.8).

shadows.name: lift-shadow
shadows.purpose: Overlapping surfaces only - the finder panel and the mobile bottom-sheet spread. Dropped when the spread docks at lg. Night run: 0 24px 54px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.85).

motion.name: ink-strike
motion.purpose: The single authored entrance: an arriving row lands from a -3px/5px registration offset with 1.5px blur clearing. Staggered 28ms per row, capped at the 14th.

motion.name: press-run
motion.purpose: Three stations (retrieving, ranking, printing) cycling at 0.18s offsets while the AI works. Replaces the spinner.

motion.name: press-sweep
motion.purpose: A 2px roller running under a field that is fetching.

motion.name: ink-pulse
motion.purpose: Wet ink on a live marker.

motion.name: edition-swap
motion.purpose: The press run changing between day and night editions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation above is disabled; ink-strike resets to opacity 1, no transform, no blur.

breakpoints.name: toc-split
breakpoints.value: 58rem (container query on the contents list, not the viewport)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink on paper. The default printed control; presses a hair into the sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-size: 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--ink, #16130f); color: var(--paper, #e4ddcd); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #16130f); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-soft, #4c443a); border-color: var(--ink-soft, #4c443a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #c1005c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Spot Button
components.description: Printed in the section's own ink. For the action that belongs to the department (save, submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-spot { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-size: 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--spot, #c1005c); color: var(--on-spot, #e4ddcd); border: 1px solid var(--spot, #c1005c); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-spot:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-spot:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-spot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16130f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A laid sheet with a hairline edge that darkens to full ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-size: 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--paper-sheet, #efe9dc); color: var(--ink, #16130f); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #b0a691); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #16130f); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #c1005c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Format Badge
components.description: A printed tag: hairline rule, square corners, tracked caps. Format variants print in their origin ink so the reader learns the source by colour.
components.html: MANHWA MANGA MURIM
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #b0a691); color: var(--ink-soft, #4c443a); background: transparent; border-radius: 0; user-select: none; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-badge-manhwa { border-color: var(--ink-blue, #2f3f96); color: var(--ink-blue, #2f3f96); } .ds-badge-manga { border-color: var(--ink-vermilion, #c33800); color: var(--ink-vermilion, #c33800); } .ds-badge-trope:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #16130f); color: var(--ink, #16130f); }

components.name: Ruled Field
components.description: The editorial desk. A 5px solid spot bar over a field ruled like a submission form; the reader writes on a line, never in a box.
components.css: .ds-desk { display: block; } .ds-desk-bar { height: 5px; background: var(--spot, #c1005c); } .ds-desk-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #16130f); transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-desk-field:focus-within { border-bottom-color: var(--spot, #c1005c); } .ds-desk-input { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; color: var(--ink, #16130f); caret-color: var(--spot, #c1005c); } .ds-desk-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint, #665c4d); } .ds-desk-submit { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-size: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--ink, #16130f); color: var(--paper, #e4ddcd); border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-desk-submit:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-desk-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #c1005c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Sections named, not iconified. Each tab sets its own --spot, so the 3px active rule prints in that department's ink.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 24px; background: var(--paper, #e4ddcd); padding: 14px 0 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #16130f); } .ds-nav-tab { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-size: 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 4px 10px; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; color: var(--ink-faint, #665c4d); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #16130f); } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--ink, #16130f); border-bottom-color: var(--spot); } .ds-nav-count { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1; padding: 2px 4px; background: var(--spot); color: var(--paper, #e4ddcd); }

components.name: Contents Entry
components.description: The signature row. Rank numeral at plate scale in its own column, cover plate, title, the editor's one-line reason, credits. No shell - a hairline is what separates one entry from the next.
components.html:
1. 2

    Solo Leveling

    WHYIn a world where awakened beings called "Hunters" must battle deadly monsters.

    MANHWA8.4201 CHKR · 2018
components.css: .ds-toc { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #b0a691); } .ds-entry { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 4px 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #b0a691); cursor: pointer; } .ds-entry-rank { font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 7vw, 6rem); line-height: 0.78; color: var(--spot, #c1005c); align-self: flex-start; min-width: 1.1em; text-align: center; } .ds-entry:hover .ds-entry-title { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--spot, #c1005c) 76%, var(--ink, #16130f)); } .ds-entry-plate { width: 72px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; background: var(--paper-plate, #cfc6b2); align-self: flex-start; flex: none; } .ds-entry-body { min-width: 0; max-width: 62ch; } .ds-entry-title { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.25; margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #16130f); transition: color 150ms; } .ds-entry-blurb { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ink-soft, #4c443a); margin: 6px 0 0; max-width: 27rem; } .ds-entry-why { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-size: 9px; margin-right: 6px; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--spot, #c1005c) 76%, var(--ink, #16130f)); } .ds-entry-credits { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 10px; margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-faint, #665c4d); }

components.name: Press Stations
components.description: The spinner replacement. Three stations light in sequence while the query retrieves, ranks and prints.
components.css: .ds-press { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.11em; font-size: 9px; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--spot, #c1005c) 76%, var(--ink, #16130f)); } @keyframes ds-press-run { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.28; } 50% { opacity: 1; } } .ds-press-stage { animation: ds-press-run 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-press-stage:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.18s; } .ds-press-stage:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.36s; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-press-stage { animation: none; } }

components.name: Issue Strip

narrative.overview:
The product is printed, not rendered. Every decision derives from a cheap weekly anthology run off a fast press: tinted pulp stock that is never white, dense process ink, one spot color per section, and hairline rules doing the work that borders and card shells used to do. The reader lands mid-issue - masthead, issue line, editorial desk, then the running order - and leaves with a title.

The world is materially honest about its press. A halftone dot screen rides over the entire app on body::after (3px grid, 0.6px dots) so the ground never reads as a flat CSS colour field. The wordmark overprints itself: one ghost of the same word 1.5px off in the spot ink, sitting behind the black, the way plates land out of register. The press mark carries registration ticks. These are the material's own devices, used natively, not decoration bolted onto a dashboard.

Two editions, not a theme toggle. The day run is ink on pulp; the night run is the reverse press run - the paper becomes the ink and the six process colours are re-mixed to full strength for dark stock, each holding 4.5:1 or better against it. What this world refuses, explicitly and by name: the near-black grid of identical cover cards with one neon accent, the metric tile, the monospace "technical" costume, and the spinner. Where an old build had a magenta #ff334b accent hardcoded on every surface, nothing hardcodes an accent now.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted pulp ground under a permanent halftone screen; no white, no pure black
One spot ink per view, inherited and re-derived per element
Zero radius everywhere; hierarchy from scale and rules, never from shells
Anton for display at size, Archivo for everything else, no monospace
One authored entrance gesture: plates striking the sheet, staggered

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: A section sets --spot once on its own container; every rule, mark, tab, badge and numeral inside it reads from that value. Nothing below the section container hardcodes an accent, and no view shows two spots at once.

rules.name: The Derived-Not-Declared Rule
rules.body: Never write a spot-tinted colour literally. Use --spot-text for small type, --spot-wash for a fill, --spot-rule for a tinted rule. A custom property resolves against the element that declares it, which is why these are declared on *.

rules.name: The No Palette Rule
rules.body: Components write bg-[var(--paper)]-style values only. A Tailwind palette colour breaks one of the two editions on contact.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Anton, Archivo, and Archivo-as-stamp. No fourth face, no monospace anywhere in the product.

rules.name: The Anton-At-Size Rule
rules.body: The display face appears at masthead, numeral, or spread-title scale and nowhere else. Anton below ~18px is a label pretending to be display; use a stamp.

rules.name: The Named-Thing Rule
rules.body: A stamp label names something the issue actually publishes - a section, an issue number, a quota, a format, a source credit. It is not a category invented to sit above a title.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Anything that lines up in a column - counts, scores, chapters, the rank - carries tabular figures. body sets 'tnum' 1 globally; .figures restates it where the element sets its own font.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is permitted on exactly one class of thing: a surface that overlaps the page (modal, bottom sheet). At lg the inspector docks and drops its shadow. In-flow content never carries one.

rules.name: The Screen Rides On Top Rule
rules.body: The halftone lives on body::after at z-index 9999, fixed and pointer-events: none. Painted under the app shell it is covered by the shell's own opaque ground and the material disappears; it must stay above everything.

rules.name: The No Shell Rule
rules.body: If something must feel separate it gets a rule or a paper shift. Never a rounded box with a border and a shadow. A card shell is the topology this world was built to refuse; retinting one would not have changed it.

rules.name: The One Gesture Rule
rules.body: Only arriving content animates on entrance. Nothing else on the page moves in, so the strike reads as the page's single gesture instead of decor.

dos: Do set --spot once, on a view's own container, and let everything inside inherit it.
Do use --spot-text for any spot-coloured type below display size; full-strength spot on small text fails contrast on pulp.
Do separate things with a rule (1px hairline, 2px ink) or a paper shift, and let scale carry hierarchy.
Do write bg-[var(--paper)]-style values; both editions depend on it.
Do keep authored classes inside @layer components - unlayered they outrank every Tailwind utility placed on the same element, silently.
Do close every view with a folio, and let the issue number come from the ISO week rather than a typed constant.
Do set counts, scores and ranks in tabular figures.
Do replace any spinner with the press bar or the three stations.
donts: Don't add corner radius. The system has one radius step and it is 0.
Don't wrap content in a bordered, shadowed box; that shell is the exact topology this world refuses.
Don't put two spot colours in one view, or hardcode an accent below the view container.
Don't introduce a fourth type face, and never monospace.
Don't use pure white or pure black; the ground is tinted stock in both editions.
Don't apply a shadow to in-flow content - shadows belong to overlapping surfaces only.
Don't paint the halftone screen below the app shell; it must ride above at z-index 9999.
Don't print rank numerals on an unordered list; a numeral with no ranking behind it is decoration.
